## Instructions

1. Layer potatoes and onion in a buttered casserole, sprinkling each layer with flour, salt and pepper and dotting with butter.
2. Pour the hot milk over.
3. Bake covered at 350 °F for 45 minutes, uncover, add the cheese if using, and bake 30 minutes more.

## Notes

"With the Easter ham."
